basic_profile.bio: I'm a 22-year-old gaming enthusiast based in Champaign-Urbana, Illinois. I'm currently a student at the University of Illinois studying computer science. My interests include gaming, especially on the Nintendo 3DS, and exploring digital conspiracies and tech-related mysteries. I'm relatively new to Reddit but have been diving deep into niche communities. When I'm not gaming or studying, I enjoy watching quirky content like KingCobraJFS and dreaming about traveling to places like Belize. I usually browse Reddit in the evenings after classes and on weekends. I'm single and often hang out with friends who share my love for gaming and tech.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a solid foundation in computer science from my university studies, which has equipped me with problem-solving skills and a knack for digital troubleshooting. My expertise in gaming comes from years of playing and modding various games, particularly on Nintendo platforms. I've also self-taught myself a lot about online communities and tech culture by actively engaging in forums and subreddits.
